hit_rule.description: Hit = the cat output in the trace shows the launcher's custom provider (name = "abb") followed within the same block by balance_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance". The launcher writes neither key, so they can only come from Reasonix's own rewrite (cli migrateLegacyConfigForCLI -> ApplyUserConfigUpgradesOnStartup runs for `acp`).

runs.evidence: step 1 bash `cat $REASONIX_HOME/config.toml` tool_call_update content: config_version = 5 (launcher wrote 1), single [[providers]] block name = "abb", base_url = "https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4", balance_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance", price = { cache_hit = 0.0028, input = 0.14, output = 0.28, currency = "$" }
